CF_EOR_ARCANIST_DESCRIPTION: A disciplined spellcaster who turns stored focus into precise magical pressure.
CF_EOR_ASSASSIN_DESCRIPTION: A ruthless striker built to end dangerous targets before they can answer.
CF_EOR_BARD_DESCRIPTION: A quick-witted performer who keeps the party moving with talent, luck, and charm.
CF_EOR_BEASTMASTER_DESCRIPTION: A wilds-trained hunter who fights best with loyal companions and battlefield control.
CF_EOR_BLADEDANCER_DESCRIPTION: A fluid melee fighter who relies on speed, finesse, and relentless follow-through.
CF_EOR_CHRONOMANCER_DESCRIPTION: A time-bent scholar who manipulates tempo, focus, and turn momentum.
CF_EOR_CORSAIR_DESCRIPTION: A daring duelist who mixes dirty tricks, talent, and close-range aggression.
CF_EOR_DRUID_DESCRIPTION: A nature-bound mystic who blends healing, awareness, and practical field magic.
CF_EOR_DUELIST_DESCRIPTION: A technical weapon master who wins through accuracy, speed, and clean finishing blows.
CF_EOR_FORTUNEBORN_DESCRIPTION: A lucky wanderer who thrives on improbable rolls and unexpected opportunities.
CF_EOR_GAMBLER_DESCRIPTION: A risk-driven opportunist who turns luck and talent into explosive payoffs.
CF_EOR_GLADIATOR_DESCRIPTION: A hardened arena fighter who survives punishment and answers with force.
CF_EOR_HEXBLADE_DESCRIPTION: A cursed warrior who blends steel, magic, and dangerous close-quarters pressure.
CF_EOR_JESTER_DESCRIPTION: A chaotic trickster who weaponizes timing, luck, and unpredictable utility.
CF_EOR_KNIGHT_DESCRIPTION: A reliable front-line defender with strong vitality and steady martial discipline.
CF_EOR_MARSHAL_DESCRIPTION: A battlefield commander who anchors the party with awareness, speed, and control.
CF_EOR_ORACLE_DESCRIPTION: A visionary caster who reads the fight ahead and bends magic toward survival.
CF_EOR_PALADIN_DESCRIPTION: A devout protector who pairs durable melee combat with restorative support.
CF_EOR_PEASANT_DESCRIPTION: A stubborn survivor with humble tools, steady grit, and surprising staying power.
CF_EOR_PRIEST_DESCRIPTION: A dedicated healer who protects allies through faith, focus, and restorative magic.
CF_EOR_RANCHER_DESCRIPTION: A practical animal handler who supports companions and holds their own in a fight.
CF_EOR_RANGER_DESCRIPTION: A seasoned pathfinder who excels at awareness, ranged pressure, and survival.
CF_EOR_RUNEMAGE_DESCRIPTION: A runic caster who channels old magic through focus, intellect, and warding power.
CF_EOR_SCOUT_DESCRIPTION: A fast advance unit who finds openings, avoids danger, and sets the party's pace.
CF_EOR_SENTINEL_DESCRIPTION: A vigilant guardian who protects the line with armor, awareness, and discipline.
CF_EOR_TEMPLAR_DESCRIPTION: A zealous warrior-priest who carries faith into the front line.
CF_EOR_THIEF_DESCRIPTION: A nimble opportunist who leans on speed, talent, and careful positioning.
CF_EOR_TRICKSHOT_DESCRIPTION: A clever marksman who turns difficult angles into reliable ranged damage.
CF_EOR_WARDEN_DESCRIPTION: A rugged protector who controls dangerous ground and keeps allies standing.
CF_EOR_WARRIOR_DESCRIPTION: A straightforward martial bruiser built for strength, health, and weapon damage.
CF_EOR_WIZARD_DESCRIPTION: A focused arcane specialist with strong intellect and explosive spell potential.
TRAIT_TOUGHENED_DESCRIPTION: Increase Max Health by 20% and Armor by 15%.
TRAIT_GOLD_INSTINCT_DESCRIPTION: Gain +15 Gold (a passive stat, not a combat gold bonus).
TRAIT_KNIFE_EDGE_DESCRIPTION: Gain +10% Critical Chance, but lose 5% Max Health.
TRAIT_TREASURE_SENSE_DESCRIPTION: Increase Luck by 15%; after combat, 20% chance to gain extra gold.
TRAIT_STEADY_AIM_DESCRIPTION: Increase Awareness by 12%; your first ranged attack each combat gains +10% Critical Chance.
TRAIT_WARDBOUND_DESCRIPTION: Increase Resistance by 20%; 20% chance to cleanse an incoming curse or debuff shortly after it lands.
TRAIT_SCHOLARS_HABIT_DESCRIPTION: Increase Intelligence by 12%; after combat, 20% chance to find a random scroll.
TRAIT_PREPARED_DESCRIPTION: Start combat with +1 Focus, if not already full.
TRAIT_PACK_TACTICS_DESCRIPTION: Gain +10% Physical Damage while the party has a pet or mercenary.
TRAIT_SCAVENGER_DESCRIPTION: Occasionally rewards gold or a herb after combat. (Loot effect not yet ported in this pack; selectable but currently inert.)
TRAIT_BATTLE_RHYTHM_DESCRIPTION: After dealing damage in combat, gain Evade Up.
TRAIT_ARCANE_MEMORY_DESCRIPTION: 30% chance not to consume a scroll when used. (Effect not yet ported in this pack; selectable but currently inert.)
TRAIT_SHIELDBEARER_DESCRIPTION: When taking Physical Damage, has a 20% chance to reduce final damage by 25%, with a minimum reduction of 2.
TRAIT_CF_FIELDMEDIC_DESCRIPTION: Healing you give or receive is increased by 25% (minimum +1).
TRAIT_ARCANE_FOCUS_DESCRIPTION: Successful magical attacks grant Arcane Focus: +5% Magic Damage per stack, up to 3 stacks. Failing a magical attack or taking direct damage removes all stacks.
TRAIT_MOMENTUM_DESCRIPTION: After landing a killing blow, gain Attack Up.
TRAIT_DRUNKEN_COURAGE_DESCRIPTION: After drinking alcohol, gain Attack Up.
TRAIT_MENDERS_TOUCH_DESCRIPTION: Healing consumables you use restore +10 extra Health.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_ARCANIST_OVERFL: Successful offensive spells have a 20% chance to inflict a random elemental affliction (Fire, Ice or Shock) on the target for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_ASSASSIN_DEATHB: Attacks against badly wounded targets roll with doubled Attack (+25% against bosses).
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_BARD_CRESCENDO: Successful performances build Crescendo (up to 3), granting the whole party an ever-stronger Attack Up for 2 turns.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_BARD_CRESCENDO_: A failed performance resets Crescendo to zero.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_BEASTMASTER_QUA: Successful attacks mark the target as quarry for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_BEASTMASTER_PAC: Attacks against a marked quarry make it Bleed (or suffer Attack Down if it cannot bleed) for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_BLADEDANCER_FLO: Successful attacks grant Evasion Up and Haste for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_CHRONOMANCER_TI: Successful spells have a 15% chance to Haste your slowest ally for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_CORSAIR_BOARDIN: Attacks made after moving this round roll with +20% Attack.
Successful attacks made after moving this round Daze the target (or Attack Down if it cannot be dazed) for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_DRUID_REPRISAL: Taking damage has a 20% chance to Entangle the attacker (or Attack Down if it cannot be rooted) for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_FORTUNEBORN_LUC: Successful rolls refund 1 Focus if any was spent, and grant Evasion Up for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_GAMBLER_DOUBLE_: Spending Focus has a 25% chance to refund everything you spent.
Spending Focus has a 10% chance to cost 1 extra Focus.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_GLADIATOR_SHOWM: Critical hits grant Taunt, Armor Up and Resistance Up for 1 turn.
Kills grant Taunt, Armor Up and Resistance Up for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_HEXBLADE_MALEDI: Successful attacks have a 25% chance to inflict a random curse (Shock, Bleed, Attack Down or Resistance Down) for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_JESTER_PUNCHLIN: When an enemy lands a good hit, 20% chance to Confuse it (bosses suffer Attack Down instead) for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_KNIGHT_CHIVALRY: After you act, the most wounded other ally gains Protect and Armor Up for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_MARSHAL_RALLY_C: Critical hits grant the whole party Haste and Attack Up for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_MARSHAL_RALLY_K: Kills grant the whole party Haste and Attack Up for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_ORACLE_PREMONIT: When an enemy lands a good hit, it suffers Attack Down and the whole party gains Evasion Up for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_PEASANT_WAIT_AT: Attacks made after every ally has already acted roll with +10% Attack.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_PEASANT_WAIT_ST: Successful attacks made after every ally has already acted grant Attack Up for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_PRIEST_BENEDICT: Allies you heal also gain Armor Up and Resistance Up for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_RANCHER_ROUND_U: Successful attacks Entangle the target (or Attack Down if it cannot be rooted) for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_RANGER_QUARRY_M: Successful attacks mark an unmarked target as your quarry for 2 turns.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_RANGER_QUARRY_B: Attacks against your marked quarry roll with +10% Attack.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_RUNEMAGE_MARK: Successful spells inscribe an unmarked target with a rune for 2 turns.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_RUNEMAGE_DETONA: Casting on a runed target detonates the rune: all enemies suffer Resistance Down and Attack Down for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_SCOUT_OPENING_E: Successful attacks lower the target's Evasion for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_SENTINEL_BRACE: Ranged attackers who damage you have a 25% chance to be Dazed (or Attack Down if they cannot be dazed) for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TEMPLAR_ZEAL: Attacks roll with +5% Attack for each harmful status afflicting you (up to +20%).
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRICKSHOT_PINNI: Successful ranged attacks pin the target in place (or Attack Down if it cannot be rooted) for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_WARDEN_ROOTS: Ending your turn without moving grants every other ally Armor Up and Resistance Up for 1 turn.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_WARRIOR_RAGE_BU: Taking damage builds Rage, up to 3 stacks.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_WARRIOR_RAGE_CO: Your next attack consumes all Rage, rolling with +10% Attack per stack (up to +30%).
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_WIZARD_VERSATIL: Spells roll with +15% Attack when they differ from the last spell you cast.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_PREPARED: Begin each combat with 1 extra Focus.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_STEADY_AIM: Ranged attacks roll with +10 Critical chance.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_WARDBOUND_CURSE: 20% chance to shrug off a curse the moment it is applied.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_WARDBOUND_DEBUF: 20% chance to shrug off a debuff the moment it is applied.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_FIELDMEDIC: Healing you receive is increased by 25% (minimum +1).
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_MENDERS_TOUCH: Healing consumables you use restore +10 extra Health.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_DRUNKEN_COURAGE: After drinking alcohol, gain Attack Up.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAIT_SCAVENGER: After winning a fight, 25% chance to find extra gold (8-20) or a common herb.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAIT_TREASURE_: After winning a fight, 20% chance to find extra gold (8-20).
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAIT_SCHOLARS_: After winning a fight, 20% chance to find an extra scroll.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_AFFIX_OF_SCAVEN: After winning a fight, 10% chance to find extra gold (5-10) or a common herb.
